description: Módulo Paradero. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Departamento Administrativo de la Defensoría del Espacio Público - DADEP. Ubicación de estructura con cubierta amplia que protege a los usuarios de la lluvia y el sol, que cuenta con un conjunto de señales, señaletica, mobiliario, dispositivos y/o instalaciones destinado a informar a los usuarios de las rutas y paradas del Sistema Integrado de Transporte Público de Bogotá D.C., adicionalmente cumple con la función de ... Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Departamento Administrativo de la Defensoría del Espacio Público - DADEP. Its tags are espacio público, mobiliario urbano, módulo, paradero. It offers 7 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
